description.value:
Aspect mind

Your relic takes over some of your mental processes and enhances others. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.Telepathy]; if you already have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.Telepathy], you instead increase its range by 30 feet. Whenever you would become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied], reduce the value by 1. You are permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Quickened] and can use the additional action to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Recall Knowledge].
